Simulated three-group network data

Source: R/data.R
simdat.Rd

A simulated dataset with known graphs: K = 3 groups, p = 50 variables and n = 150 observations per group, generated by simulate_ssjgl_data with scale-free graphs (seed 2022). The groups share a scale-free base graph; each group's graph is the base graph with 5\ group 1.

Usage

simdat

Format

A list with elements

Y

List of 3 data matrices, each 150 x 50, with columns V1, ..., V50.

g

List of 3 true adjacency matrices (50 x 50, 0/1).

Omega

List of 3 true precision matrices (50 x 50).

Source

data-raw/simdat.R in the package sources.

Examples

str(simdat, max.level = 1)
#> List of 3
#>  $ Y    :List of 3
#>  $ g    :List of 3
#>  $ Omega:List of 3
sapply(simdat$g, function(a) sum(a[upper.tri(a)]))  # edges per group
#> [1]  49 106 104
